spoken_freq.source: tagged corpus (Tatoeba swh + OPUS GlobalVoices en-sw + FLORES-200 swh_Latn), (lemma, POS) token counts from the rule-based lemmatiser
spoken_freq.note: approximate ranking: no Swahili subtitle or wordfreq list exists

written_freq.source: the same corpus's surface counts (wordfreq has no Swahili)

tagger.source: rule-based Swahili tokeniser and lemmatiser (vocab-engine packbuilder langs/sw.py) over the kaikki.org Swahili Wiktionary extract
tagger.note: Used at build time only. No statistical tagger exists for Swahili.

audio.note: no recorded Swahili audio: browser TTS (sw-KE / sw-TZ voices exist on Android Chrome; most desktop browsers have none)

written_examples.source: written for this pack (tools/generated_examples.tsv) and reviewed; marked "src": "gen"
written_examples.note: Example sentences only, for words whose corpus sentences are missing or dropped by policy; no audio.

globalvoices.source: OPUS GlobalVoices v2018q4 en-sw (Global Voices, globalvoices.org)
globalvoices.note: frequency corpus; short everyday sentences also used as examples, marked "src": "gv"

flores.note: frequency corpus; short sentences also used as examples, marked "src": "flores"
